sampling: Nearest recorded observation, ties choose earlier, maximum 20 ms error; no interpolation
time_basis: source_timestamp_ms; sample targets run backward from the declared observed endpoint
coordinates: SportVU source court feet; no rotation, reflection, direction normalization or scale change

profiles.start_relative: Subtract each path's first sampled x/y; preserve source-axis orientation

duration_treatment: Fixed nominal 2 s, actual endpoint span within 20 ms; no temporal rescaling or warping
candidates: Observed endpoints nearest an absolute 2 s timestamp grid within source event windows; deduplicate identical sampled player paths across overlaps
quality: All intervening selected-player observations must be unique, roster/team-consistent, finite and within court; no timing/period/clock breaks or timestamp conflicts
query: Ends at selected annotation reference or indexed path endpoint; only observations at/before that endpoint; curated queries stay within curated clip bounds
retrieval_exclusions: Exclude all-player candidate intervals overlapping query footage in the same game, then suppress overlapping returned footage; stable ID breaks score ties
